$description: khyzr's design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens format.

khyzr-green.$description: the primary green · 6.9:1 on paper, safe for text as it stands

forest.$description: the deep green: hover, pressed, deep fills

green-100.$description: pale mint · also a gradient stop

green-900.$description: the deep green of dark surfaces · gradient anchor

leaf.$description: bright leaf: a stop of the gradient, the hero orb's low tone, the mesh's light look · never text, never interface

surface-2.$description: sections set apart, resting cards, plates

hairline-strong.$description: a hairline under the pointer: the border of a control on hover

faint.$description: rules and large type · never small text: 3.2:1 on white

muted.$description: secondary text · captions and labels (5.9:1 on white)

pitch.$description: dark surfaces · gradient anchor · never a text color

on-dark-faint.$description: labels and legal on ink and pitch (5:1) · on green-900 it falls to 3.6:1: large text only there

link.$description: a link in a document or on a reference page · the primary is text-safe

accent.$description: the one green phrase, a dot, a rule

info.$description: informational chips, links out, scheduled states

error.$description: feedback only, never in a chart

signal.$description: flags, negatives, annotations only · never a series, never chrome

signal-text.$description: terracotta for small text and on tints

signal-tint.$description: the wash behind a signal chip

gradient-hero.$description: pitch, green-900, forest, leaf, mint, green-100, paper

gradient-hero-srgb.$description: the same ramp for a renderer without OKLab

fw-ui.$description: interface, and a name inside a card or a list

text-hero-word.$description: the uppercase hero word: display, fw-display, -0.02em

tracking-eyebrow.$description: eyebrows, captions in the technical register

section-pad-y.$description: between a section's content and a change of ground

container.$description: the column's cap; khyzr.com narrows it on a curve under 2560px wide

break-phone.$description: at and below, a layout takes its phone form · a media query cannot read a custom property, so the query types the value

radius-s.$description: small chips, a text link's focus shape

radius-m.$description: cards, icon tiles, form plates, code blocks

radius-pill.$description: all buttons, nav links, round controls

shadow-float.$description: a sheet that floats at rest

shadow-held.$description: the same sheet while it is held

z-scrollbar.$description: a custom scrollbar, over the navigation

ease-drift.$description: growing bars, widths and rules; a card's lift

dur-color.$description: a color, a border or a ground answering the pointer, on the standard ease

dur-surface.$description: a surface changing state, on the standard ease: the navigation's flip

rise-scale.$description: the scale an entrance grows from
